title: The Moundhalaverse
tagline: This site. An interactive WebGL solar system where every planet is a section of my work.
description: A personal portfolio built as a real-time 3D scene. Procedurally shaded planets orbit a sun, and clicking one flies the camera in and opens that section. Content lives in schema-validated collections so the site can never drift out of sync with my resume, and every interaction has a keyboard and reduced-motion path.

title: Roots
tagline: An all-in-one hiking companion for planning a day on the trail.
description: A web application that pulls trail information together in one place, with a live weather feature backed by a third-party weather API and a parallax-scrolling interface built to make route planning feel less like reading a spreadsheet.
